rationale: A trial is a durable execution-planning unit distinct from its task definition. Its digest provides a content-addressed identity for the exact trial entry, including its placement and inherited run/shard context, without conflating it with task_digest.
alternatives: derive from task_digest: unsafe when the same task is planned in more than one trial or context
remove: loses a stable content-addressed trial identity
simplestChoice: Keep trial_digest as the required content-addressed identity of a trial.
